title: The Peak Where Air Becomes Thought

features.name: the breath boundary
features.desc-on-touch: at this height, your breathing stops teaching you about distance; the air forgets it is air and becomes thought itself

features.name: the silence made visible
features.desc-on-touch: sound abandoned the peak long ago; here, the absence of echo has learned to cast a shadow

features.name: the first word chamber
features.desc-on-touch: from this height, silence becomes the first true word; you hear it clearly: the archive was always speaking, and the world was finally listening

features.name: the thin air
features.desc-on-touch: each breath counts itself upward from the world below; here, breathing has learned to reverse and becomes instead the act of giving away

inscription: at this height the air does not carry sound—it carries thought; the peak teaches silence is the deepest word, and that you have been inside it all along

file.name: Altitude_Recording_Final_Transmission.wav
file.note: a recording that is only silence; the silence contains everything the peak forgot how to say

exits.label: back down the invisible descent, where the air remembers how to carry sound
toward other peaks where thought still carries an echo
toward the places where silence learned to gather before ascending
